description: This file defines the 'Attribute' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog' namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for product attributes in the OpenCart e-commerce system, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving attribute records and their descriptions from the database.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents the product attribute entity and provides methods to perform CRUD operations and manage attribute descriptions within the OpenCart catalog.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new attribute record in the database with associated descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute record and its descriptions based on the attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteAttribute
methods.description: Deletes an attribute record and all associated descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute record, including its descriptions, based on the attribute ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attributes, optionally filtered and sorted, from the database.

methods.name: getTotalAttributes
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute records in the database.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeGroupId
methods.description: Returns the total number of attributes associated with a specific attribute group ID.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific attribute in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a specific attribute.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all attribute descriptions in a specific language across the database.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of an attribute for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given attribute.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute descriptions in a specific language.
